Categories: AI, EDA

Daniel is joined by the CEO of Cognichip, Faraj Aalaei, a successful visionary entrepreneur with over 40 years of distinguished experience in communications and networking technologies. As a leading entrepreneur in Silicon Valley, he was responsible for building and leading two semiconductor companies through IPOs as a founder and CEO.
Daniel explores the growing impact of AI deployment with Faraj, who discusses the critical need to develop custom enabling AI chips faster to keep pace with ever-growing need. Faraj discusses the shortcomings of AI-assisted hardware design today and describes the need for AI models that understand the physics of chip design. Faraj describes the work at Cognichip to develop a type of AI that learns, understands, and solves design problems at designer-level cognitive abilities. He explains that this technology is being deployed as the industry’s first full-stack intelligence infrastructure for chip design.
